startedAt.description: ISO 8601, per run (v1 comparisons shared one root scannedAt).

recipients.description: Third-party domains the sentinel was sent to.

encodings.description: Encodings the sentinel appeared in (plain, base64, hex, sha256, ...).

fieldsTyped.description: How many form fields the probe typed into.

fieldTypes.description: The input types probed (text, email, password, search, ...).

platform.description: Catalogue entity name (e.g. "Meta"), aligned with HEADLINE_PLATFORMS.

events.description: Event names observed (configuration signals, never visitor PII).

advancedMatching.description: Personal-data categories attached, detected by key presence only.

requests.description: Pixel requests observed for this platform in this visit.

choiceState.description: Derived by the shared evaluator from the observations.

reverifiedAfterReload.description: true iff a post-choice-reload observation exists and agrees.

observed.description: The normalized state read; null = interpreter ran, nothing readable.

ConsentObservationResultR2.description: Structurally OPTIONAL so the r2 schema stays a superset of r1; the r2 evaluator makes it MANDATORY on every observation present in an r2 consent run. Discriminated: each outcome pins its allowed error code.

ConsentObservedState.description: Normalized consent state (RFC 9.4): never the raw CMP payload. Interpreters map whatever they read into this closed vocabulary before anything persists.

atMs.description: Must lie inside the referenced phase's span; strictly before < after (< reload).

cookie.description: State after the op (or last state, for "removed").

CnameCloak.description: A CNAME-cloaked tracker: a first-party-looking subdomain the page contacted (`host`) that is a DNS CNAME alias for a third-party tracking service (`tracker`, reached via `cname`), which request-URL matching alone misses.

PixelMatchField.description: A personal-data category an advertising pixel attached to its events ("advanced matching" in Meta's terms). Detected by parameter-key presence only: the scanner never reads, decodes, or stores the (usually hashed) value.

url.description: Redacted URL of the policy page that was read.

claims.description: Checkable statements matched in the policy text.

mentionedEntities.description: Observed tracking companies whose name (or alias) appears in the policy.

unmentionedEntities.description: Observed tracking companies never named in the policy text.

policyTextLength.description: Characters of policy text analyzed (evidence the fetch worked).

PrivacyPolicySummary.description: What the scanner found when it read the site's own privacy policy and compared it against the observed evidence. Best-effort and Node-scanner only: the policy page is discovered from the scanned page's links and fetched through the same SSRF-guarded browser context.

PrivacyPolicyClaimKind.description: A specific, checkable statement found in the site's privacy policy by a conservative sentence-level text match. `quote` is the matched sentence (capped) so a reader can verify the match in context; this is an automated text match, never a legal reading of the policy.

observedOn.description: The only scope in r2; sampled scopes are deferred to a later revision.

phaseId.description: Must reference a passive-load phase containing the eligible navigation.
The passive-load phase of the engine-status observation.

observed.description: Derived from the FINAL url; the measured subject and comparison identity.

origin.description: Normalized privacy-safe origin: lowercase, IDN as punycode A-label, default port stripped, token-like subdomain labels generalized (RFC 9.1).

acquisition.description: What asked for the measurement; CI is an orchestrator, not a scanner.

buildCommit.description: Self-reported, machine-checkable metadata, not cryptographic proof.

methodologyVersion.description: Meaning of the numbers; distinct from schemaVersion (shape).

detectorRegistry.description: The known-detector set itself is versioned.

sourceArtifactDigest.description: e.g. sha256 of an imported PageGraph GraphML.

manifestDigest.description: Aggregate digest; keys the published immutable per-list digest manifest.

Toolchain.description: The digests/versions the fingerprints hash, stored on the run (RFC 3.5).

execution.description: Exact reproducibility: full conditions + buildCommit + methodology + registries + toolchain.

measurementEnvironment.description: Behavior-affecting environment EXCLUDING the intervention axes' values and buildCommit. Equal values mean "measured the same way"; intervention state may still differ.

condition.description: The complete condition vector alone. Equal values mean "same requested setup".

Fingerprints.description: RFC 3.2: three digests over canonical JSON. Stored beside their inputs (conditions, provenance, toolchain), so every fingerprint is recomputable from the report itself.

QualityFacts.description: Recorded facts; producers never declare quality directly (RFC 5.3).

phaseId.description: null = not attributable to a phase.

run.description: Run-level: did the page load produce a valid observation at all?

byFamily.description: Family-level censoring; one family's loss never contaminates another.

QualityReason.description: Normative initial vocabulary (RFC 5.3); extensible only with an evaluatorVersion bump. Parameterized codes use "code:qualifier".

PrivacyStats.description: Redaction is expected behavior, never censoring (RFC 5.2).

pairId.description: Random id shared by both runs of the pair.

order.description: Counterbalanced across pairs from the first v2 release.

InterventionExperimentR2.description: supportingPairs exist ONLY on intervention experiments.

expected.description: The condition the arm was supposed to run under.

observed.description: What the interpreter actually read; null = unobservable.

InterventionAxis.description: The axes an experiment may move. Everything else is environment.

AxisState.description: Closed axis-state vocabulary (RFC 9.4): arm expectations and observations are scanner-controlled codes, never page-derived strings.

pairValidity.description: Structural: observed subjects match, the experiment is well-formed for its kind, and BOTH runs are run-level complete. Matching failure statuses never make a pair valid.

perMetric.description: Per metric family; split eligibility is the point (RFC example 12.3).

interventionVerified.description: ONLY present when experiment.kind === "intervention": both arms passed. Gates intervention-ATTRIBUTED claims, not family eligibility.

ComparabilityReason.description: Normative initial reason vocabulary (RFC 4.4); extensible only with a metricRegistryVersion or evaluatorVersion bump.

metrics.description: null when either run recorded no Shields count.

ComparisonDiffV2.description: Normative r1 diff. Derivable from the two runs alone (the shared builder in lib/scan-report-v2-evaluators.ts is the definition; semantic validation rejects any diff that does not equal the rebuilt one), organized per metric family, carrying each family's eligibility (mirrored from comparability.perMetric) so renderers cannot show an ineligible delta.
